R-45 Inspection ROV with 8 kg Payload

A tethered inspection platform with a higher brochure payload than the R-30, for projects needing additional sensing or tooling.

Back to R-45

Specifications

Vehicle weight42 kg
Depth rating350 m

Dimensions675 × 500 × 445 mm

Applications

  • Visual inspection of dams, intakes and submerged infrastructure
  • Tasks that need a larger integrated sensor package
  • Projects with suitable deployment space and vehicle handling

Checks before quotation

  • Evaluate the complete payload and its effect on vehicle balance.
  • Confirm the launch method, available power and recovery equipment.
  • Define data outputs and the accuracy needed from optional positioning.
